shloka_text: वाल्मीकिनैवमुक्तस्तु राघवः प्रत्यभाषत । प्राञ्जलिर्जगतो मध्ये दृष्ट्वा तां वरवर्णिनीम् ।। 7.97.1 ।।
transliteration: vālmīkinaivamuktastu rāghavaḥ pratyabhāṣata | prāñjalirjagato madhye dṛṣṭvā tāṃ varavarṇinīm || 7.97.1 ||
translation: वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, राघवः Rama, प्रत्यभाषत replied, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, जगतः of the world, मध्ये in the midst, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तां her, वरवर्णिनीम् of excellent complexion.
explanation: Indeed, when spoken to thus by Valmiki, Rama, having seen Sita of excellent complexion in the midst of the people, replied with folded hands.
comments: Rama accepts Valmiki's word, owning that he abandoned the pure Sita only for fear of scandal, and acknowledges Kusha and Lava as his sons -- as the gods assemble, Sita swears that, having never thought of any man but Rama, may the Earth receive her, whereupon a naga-borne throne rises and Mother Earth takes her upon it and bears her down into the netherworld amid a rain of flowers, all beings standing astonished.

shloka_text: एवमेतन्महाभाग यथा वदसि धर्मवित् । प्रत्ययस्तु मम ब्रह्मंस्तव वाक्यैरकल्मषैः ।। 7.97.2 ।।
transliteration: evametanmahābhāga yathā vadasi dharmavit | pratyayastu mama brahmaṃstava vākyairakalmaṣaiḥ || 7.97.2 ||
translation: एवम् thus, एतत् this, महाभाग O great fortunate one, यथा as, वदसि you say, धर्मवित् O knower of dharma, प्रत्ययः conviction, तु indeed, मम my, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, तव your, वाक्यैः by words, अकल्मषैः sinless.
explanation: O great fortunate one, O knower of dharma, this is indeed as you say, and my conviction is established by your pure words, O Brahmana.

shloka_text: प्रत्ययस्तु पुरा वृत्तो वैदेह्याः सुरसन्निधौ । शपथस्तु कृतस्तत्र तेन वेश्म प्रवेशिता । लोकापवादो बलवान्येन त्यक्ता हि मैथिली ।। 7.97.3 ।।
transliteration: pratyayastu purā vṛtto vaidehyāḥ surasannidhau | śapathastu kṛtastatra tena veśma praveśitā | lokāpavādo balavānyena tyaktā hi maithilī || 7.97.3 ||
translation: प्रत्ययस्तु assurance but, पुरा formerly, वृत्तो occurred, वैदेह्याः of Vaidehi, सुरसन्निधौ in the presence of gods, शपथस्तु oath but, कृतस्तत्र made there, तेन by that, वेश्म home, प्रवेशिता was made to enter, लोकापवादो public scandal, बलवान् powerful, येन by which, त्यक्ता abandoned, हि indeed, मैथिली Maithili.
explanation: Although Vaidehi's purity was previously proven by an oath taken in the presence of the gods, and she was admitted back into the home, the powerful public scandal compelled me to abandon Maithili.

shloka_text: सेयं लोकभयाद्ब्रह्मन्नपापेत्यभिजानता । परित्यक्ता मया सीता तद्भावन्क्षन्तुमर्हति ।। 7.97.4 ।।
transliteration: seyaṃ lokabhayādbrahmannapāpetyabhijānatā | parityaktā mayā sītā tadbhāvankṣantumarhati || 7.97.4 ||
translation: सेयं she this, लोकभयाद् from fear of public opinion, ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, अपापेत्यभिजानता knowing her to be sinless, परित्यक्ता abandoned, मया by me, सीता Sita, तद्भावन् that you, क्षन्तुमर्हति should forgive.
explanation: O Brahman, knowing her to be sinless, I abandoned Sita out of fear of public opinion, and for this, you should forgive me.

shloka_text: जानामि चेमौ पुत्रौ मे यमजातौ कुशीलवौ । शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये मैथिल्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे ।। 7.97.5 ।।
transliteration: jānāmi cemau putrau me yamajātau kuśīlavau | śuddhāyāṃ jagato madhye maithilyāṃ prītirastu me || 7.97.5 ||
translation: जानामि I know, चेमौ and these two, पुत्रौ sons, मे my, यमजातौ twins, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, शुद्धायां pure, जगतो of the world, मध्ये in the midst, मैथिल्यां in Maithili, प्रीतिरस्तु let there be affection, मे my.
explanation: I know that these two, Kusha and Lava, are my twin sons, and I desire that my affection for Maithili, who is pure in the eyes of the world, be restored.

shloka_text: अभिप्रायं तु विज्ञाय रामस्य सुरसत्तमाः । सीतायाः शपथे तस्मिन् महेन्द्राद्या महौजसः ।। 7.97.6 ।।
transliteration: abhiprāyaṃ tu vijñāya rāmasya surasattamāḥ | sītāyāḥ śapathe tasmin mahendrādyā mahaujasaḥ || 7.97.6 ||
translation: अभिप्रायं intention, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having understood, रामस्य of Rama, सुरसत्तमाः best among gods, सीतायाः of Sita, शपथे in the oath, तस्मिन् in that, महेन्द्राद्या Mahendra and others, महौजसः greatly powerful.
explanation: Having understood Rama's intention regarding Sita's oath, the greatly powerful best among gods, led by Mahendra (Indra), prepared to act.

shloka_text: पितामहं पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.97.7 ।।
transliteration: pitāmahaṃ puraskṛtya sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.97.7 ||
translation: पितामहं Grandfather (Brahma), पुरस्कृत्य having made the leader, सर्व all, एव indeed, समागताः assembled.
explanation: All of them, indeed, assembled, making Grandfather Brahma their leader.

shloka_text: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा ह्यश्विनौ समरुद्गणाः । गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.97.8 ।।
transliteration: ādityā vasavo rudrā hyaśvinau samarudgaṇāḥ | gandharvāpsarasaścaiva sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.97.8 ||
translation: आदित्याः Adityas, वसवः Vasus, रुद्राः Rudras, हि indeed, अश्विनौ the two Ashvins, समरुद्गणाः along with the groups of Maruts, गन्धर्वाप्सरसः Gandharvas and Apsaras, च and, एव indeed, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः had assembled.
explanation: The Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, the two Ashvins along with the Maruts, Gandharvas, and Apsaras, all indeed had assembled there.

shloka_text: साध्याश्च विश्वेदेवाश्च सर्वे च परमर्षयः । नागाः सुपर्णाः सिद्धाश्च ते सर्वे हृष्टमानसाः । सीताशपथसम्भ्रान्ताः सर्व एव समागताः ।। 7.97.9 ।।
transliteration: sādhyāśca viśvedevāśca sarve ca paramarṣayaḥ | nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ siddhāśca te sarve hṛṣṭamānasāḥ | sītāśapathasambhrāntāḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ || 7.97.9 ||
translation: साध्याः Sadhyas, च and, विश्वेदेवाः Vishvedevas, च and, सर्वे all, च and, परमर्षयः great sages, नागाः Nagas, सुपर्णाः Suparnas, सिद्धाः Siddhas, च and, ते they, सर्वे all, हृष्टमानसाः with joyful minds, सीताशपथसम्भ्रान्ताः agitated by Sita's oath, सर्वे all, एव indeed, समागताः had assembled.
explanation: The Sadhyas, Vishvedevas, all great sages, Nagas, Suparnas, and Siddhas, all of them with joyful minds, agitated by Sita's oath, had indeed assembled there.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा देवानृषींश्चैव राघवः पुनरब्रवीत् । प्रत्ययो मे नरश्रेष्ठा ऋषिवाक्यैरकल्मषैः ।। 7.97.10 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devānṛṣīṃścaiva rāghavaḥ punarabravīt | pratyayo me naraśreṣṭhā ṛṣivākyairakalmaṣaiḥ || 7.97.10 ||
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवान् the gods, ऋषीन् and the sages, च and, एव indeed, राघवः Rama, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रत्ययः faith/conviction, मे is for me, नरश्रेष्ठाः O best among men, ऋषिवाक्यैः by the words of the sages, अकल्मषैः which are faultless.
explanation: Having seen the gods and sages, Rama spoke again, saying, "O best among men, I have conviction in the faultless words of the sages."

shloka_text: शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये वैदेह्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे ।। 7.97.11 ।।
transliteration: śuddhāyāṃ jagato madhye vaidehyāṃ prītirastu me || 7.97.11 ||
translation: शुद्धायाम् in the pure one, जगतः of the world, मध्ये in the midst, वैदेह्याम् in Vaidehi (Sita), प्रीतिः affection/love, अस्तु let there be, मे for me.
explanation: Let my affection for Vaidehi, who is pure in the midst of the world, be firm.

shloka_text: ततो वायुः शुभः पुण्यो दिव्यगन्धो मनोरमः । तज्जनौघं सुरश्रेष्ठो ह्लादयामास सर्वतः ।। 7.97.12 ।।
transliteration: tato vāyuḥ śubhaḥ puṇyo divyagandho manoramaḥ | tajjanaughaṃ suraśreṣṭho hlādayāmāsa sarvataḥ || 7.97.12 ||
translation: ततः then, वायुः the wind, शुभः auspicious, पुण्यः sacred, दिव्यगन्धः with divine fragrance, मनोरमः delightful, तत् that, जनौघम् multitude of people, सुरश्रेष्ठः best among gods (referring to Vayu, the god of wind), ह्लादयामास delighted, सर्वतः from all sides.
explanation: Then, the auspicious, sacred, divinely fragrant, and delightful wind, the best among gods (Vayu), delighted that multitude of people from all sides.

shloka_text: तदद्भुतमिवाचिन्त्यं निरैक्षन्त समागताः । मानवाः सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यः पूर्वं कृतयुगे यथा ।। 7.97.13 ।।
transliteration: tadadbhutamivācintyaṃ niraikṣanta samāgatāḥ | mānavāḥ sarvarāṣṭrebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge yathā || 7.97.13 ||
translation: तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, इव as if, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, निरैक्षन्त they beheld, समागताः assembled, मानवाः humans, सर्वराष्ट्रेभ्यः from all kingdoms, पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, यथा as.
explanation: People gathered from all kingdoms beheld that wonderful and inconceivable sight, just as they would have in the Krita Yuga.

shloka_text: सर्वान्समागतान्दृष्ट्वा सीता काषायवासिनी । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमधोदृष्टिरवाङ्मुखी ।। 7.97.14 ।।
transliteration: sarvānsamāgatāndṛṣṭvā sītā kāṣāyavāsinī | abravītprāñjalirvākyamadhodṛṣṭiravāṅmukhī || 7.97.14 ||
translation: सर्वान् all, समागतान् assembled ones, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सीता Sita, काषायवासिनी clad in ochre robes, अब्रवीत् she spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यम् words, अधोदृष्टिः with downcast eyes, अवाङ्मुखी with face turned downwards.
explanation: Having seen all the assembled people, Sita, clad in ochre robes, spoke with folded hands, her eyes and face cast downwards.

shloka_text: यथा ऽहं राघवादन्यं मनसापि न चिन्तये । तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ।। 7.97.15 ।।
transliteration: yathā 'haṃ rāghavādanyaṃ manasāpi na cintaye | tathā me mādhavī devī vivaraṃ dātumarhati || 7.97.15 ||
translation: यथा just as, अहम् I, राघवात् from Rama, अन्यम् another, मनसा by mind, अपि even, न not, चिन्तये I think, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.
explanation: Sita prayed, "Just as I do not think of any other man than Rama even in my mind, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

shloka_text: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा यथा रामं समर्चये । तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ।। 7.97.16 ।।
transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā yathā rāmaṃ samarcaye | tathā me mādhavī devī vivaraṃ dātumarhati || 7.97.16 ||
translation: मनसा by mind, कर्मणा by action, वाचा by speech, यथा just as, रामम् Rama, समर्चये I worship, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.
explanation: Sita prayed, "Just as I worship Rama with my mind, actions, and speech, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

shloka_text: यथैतत्सत्यमुक्तं मे वेद्मि रामात्परं न च । तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति ।। 7.97.17 ।।
transliteration: yathaitatsatyamuktaṃ me vedmi rāmātparaṃ na ca | tathā me mādhavī devī vivaraṃ dātumarhati || 7.97.17 ||
translation: यथा just as, एतत् this, सत्यम् truth, उक्तम् spoken, मे by me, वेद्मि I know, रामात् than Rama, परम् superior, न not, च and, तथा so, मे to me, माधवी daughter of Madhu (Earth), देवी goddess, विवरम् an opening, दातुम् to give, अर्हति she ought.
explanation: Sita prayed, "Just as this truth has been spoken by me and I know no one superior to Rama, so may Goddess Earth grant me an opening."

shloka_text: तथा शपन्त्यां वैदेह्यां प्रादुरासीत्तदद्भुतम् । भूतलादुत्थितं दिव्यं सिंहासनमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.97.18 ।।
transliteration: tathā śapantyāṃ vaidehyāṃ prādurāsīttadadbhutam | bhūtalādutthitaṃ divyaṃ siṃhāsanamanuttamam || 7.97.18 ||
translation: तथा thus, शपन्त्यां while swearing, वैदेह्यां by Vaidehi, प्रादुरासीत् appeared, तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, भूतलात् from the surface of the earth, उत्थितं risen, दिव्यं divine, सिंहासनम् throne, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.
explanation: As Vaidehi was thus swearing, a wonderful, divine, and unsurpassed throne emerged from the surface of the earth.

shloka_text: ध्रियमाणं शिरोभिस्तु नागैरमितविक्रमैः । दिव्यं दिव्येन वपुषा दिव्यरत्नविभूषितैः ।। 7.97.19 ।।
transliteration: dhriyamāṇaṃ śirobhistu nāgairamitavikramaiḥ | divyaṃ divyena vapuṣā divyaratnavibhūṣitaiḥ || 7.97.19 ||
translation: ध्रियमाणं being held, शिरोभिः by heads, तु and, नागैः by Nagas, अमितविक्रमैः of immeasurable valor, दिव्यं divine, दिव्येन with divine, वपुषा bodies, दिव्यरत्नविभूषितैः adorned with divine jewels.
explanation: This divine throne was being held by the heads of Nagas of immeasurable valor, who themselves possessed divine bodies adorned with divine jewels.

shloka_text: तस्मिंस्तु धरणी देवी बाहुभ्यां गृह्य मैथिलीम् । स्वागतेनाभिनन्द्यैनामासने चोपवेशयत् ।। 7.97.20 ।।
transliteration: tasmiṃstu dharaṇī devī bāhubhyāṃ gṛhya maithilīm | svāgatenābhinandyaināmāsane copaveśayat || 7.97.20 ||
translation: तस्मिन् on that, तु and, धरणी the Earth, देवी goddess, बाहुभ्यां with two arms, गृह्य taking, मैथिलीम् Maithili, स्वागतेन with a welcome, अभिनन्द्य having greeted, एनाम् her, आसने on the seat, च and, उपवेशयत् made her sit.
explanation: Then, Goddess Earth, taking Maithili with her two arms, greeted her with a welcome and made her sit upon that throne.

shloka_text: तामासनगतां दृष्ट्वा प्रविशन्तीं रसातलम् । पुष्पवृष्टिरविच्छिन्ना दिव्या सीतामवाकिरत् ।। 7.97.21 ।।
transliteration: tāmāsanagatāṃ dṛṣṭvā praviśantīṃ rasātalam | puṣpavṛṣṭiravicchinnā divyā sītāmavākirat || 7.97.21 ||
translation: ताम् her, आसनगतां seated on the throne, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रविशन्तीं entering, रसातलम् the netherworld, पुष्पवृष्टिः a shower of flowers, अविच्छिन्ना uninterrupted, दिव्या divine, सीताम् upon Sita, अवाकिरत् showered.
explanation: As Sita, seated on the throne, was seen entering the netherworld, an uninterrupted divine shower of flowers fell upon her.

shloka_text: साधुकारश्च सुमहान्देवानां सहसोत्थितः । साधु साध्विति वै सीते यस्यास्ते शीलमीदृशम् ।। 7.97.22 ।।
transliteration: sādhukāraśca sumahāndevānāṃ sahasotthitaḥ | sādhu sādhviti vai sīte yasyāste śīlamīdṛśam || 7.97.22 ||
translation: साधुकारः an acclamation of well done, च and, सुमहान् very great, देवानां of the gods, सहसा suddenly, उत्थितः arose, साधु well done, साधु well done, इति thus, वै indeed, सीते O Sita, यस्याः whose, ते your, शीलम् character, ईदृशम् such.
explanation: A very great acclamation of "well done" suddenly arose from the gods, praising, "Well done, well done, O Sita, whose character is indeed of such purity!"

shloka_text: एवं बहुविधा वाचो ह्यन्तरिक्षगताः सुराः । व्याजह्रुर्हृष्टमनसो दृष्ट्वा सीताप्रवेशनम् ।। 7.97.23 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhā vāco hyantarikṣagatāḥ surāḥ | vyājahrurhṛṣṭamanaso dṛṣṭvā sītāpraveśanam || 7.97.23 ||
translation: एवम् thus, बहुविधाः various, वाचः words, हि indeed, अन्तरिक्षगताः celestial, सुराः gods, व्याजह्रुः uttered, हृष्टमनसः with joyful minds, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सीताप्रवेशनम् Sita's entry.
explanation: The celestial gods, with joyful minds, uttered various words upon witnessing Sita's entry into the earth.

shloka_text: यज्ञवाटगताश्चापि मुनयः सर्व एव ते । राजानश्च नरव्याघ्रा विस्मयान्नोपरेमिरे ।। 7.97.24 ।।
transliteration: yajñavāṭagatāścāpi munayaḥ sarva eva te | rājānaśca naravyāghrā vismayānnoparemire || 7.97.24 ||
translation: यज्ञवाटगताः those in the sacrificial enclosure, च and, अपि also, मुनयः sages, सर्वे all, एव indeed, ते those, राजानः kings, च and, नरव्याघ्राः best among men, विस्मयात् from astonishment, न not, उपरेमिरे ceased.
explanation: All those sages and kings, who were like tigers among men, present in the sacrificial enclosure, did not cease their astonishment.

shloka_text: अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च सर्वे स्थावरजङ्गमाः । दानवाश्च महाकायाः पाताले पन्नगाधिपाः ।। 7.97.25 ।।
transliteration: antarikṣe ca bhūmau ca sarve sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ | dānavāśca mahākāyāḥ pātāle pannagādhipāḥ || 7.97.25 ||
translation: अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, च and, भूमौ on the earth, च and, सर्वे all, स्थावरजङ्गमाः stationary and moving beings, दानवाः demons, च and, महाकायाः of huge bodies, पाताले in the netherworld, पन्नगाधिपाः lords of serpents.
explanation: All stationary and moving beings in the sky and on the earth, along with the huge-bodied demons and the lords of serpents in the netherworld, were present.

shloka_text: केचिद्विनेदुः संहृष्टाः केचिद्ध्यानपरायणाः । केचिद्रामं निरीक्षन्ते केचित्सीतामचेतनाः ।। 7.97.26 ।।
transliteration: kecidvineduḥ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ keciddhyānaparāyaṇāḥ | kecidrāmaṃ nirīkṣante kecitsītāmacetanāḥ || 7.97.26 ||
translation: केचित् some, विनेदुः roared, संहृष्टाः greatly delighted, केचित् some, ध्यानपरायणाः absorbed in meditation, केचित् some, रामम् Rama, निरीक्षन्ते gazed at, केचित् some, सीताम् Sita, अचेतनाः stunned.
explanation: Some, greatly delighted, roared; some were absorbed in meditation; some gazed at Rama, while others, stunned, looked at Sita.

shloka_text: सीताप्रवेशनं दृष्ट्वा तेषामासीत्समागमः । तन्मुहूर्तमिवात्यर्थं समं सम्मोहितं जगत् ।। 7.97.27 ।।
transliteration: sītāpraveśanaṃ dṛṣṭvā teṣāmāsītsamāgamaḥ | tanmuhūrtamivātyarthaṃ samaṃ sammohitaṃ jagat || 7.97.27 ||
translation: सीताप्रवेशनम् Sita's entry, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तेषाम् among them, आसीत् there was, समागमः a gathering, तत् that, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, इव as if, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, समम् entirely, सम्मोहितम् bewildered, जगत् the world.
explanation: Upon witnessing Sita's entry, there was a great gathering of beings, and for a moment, the entire world seemed exceedingly bewildered. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 97 ।। Thus ends the ninety-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
